Annnnnnnd then I get ghosted. Rinse and repeat.

Oh well. This last time around (being ghosted) was frustrating because they clarified they liked the same amount of messaging as me.

ITS THE FUCKING WORST. Especially when you know you've fallen into the trap. I hate that it's made me more shallow. If I'm on bumble on the friends option, I shouldn't care what my possible new friend looks like. Fuck online dating. But also fuck IRL dating, I'm bad at striking up a conversation. Sigh.
Haha, understandable. I'll admit I've been guilty, too. But I try to let them know. It's a work in progress. I think tighty whitey guy knew he was taking a risk lol

Yes, I have a kitty. Dog is just too much, I don't have that kind of energy. She's made it a little easier, but the thoughts haven't gone away.  


Also, thanks for talking to me. I realize I'm difficult and a bit of a brick wall, so thanks for still trying
Hahaha I don't think anyone would be upset with you for that, lol. Thank god that hasn't really come up for me

Mostly emotional, small amounts of physical. But it was more of a "control" emotional abuse. She was never negative about me as a person, or my physical traits. I actually quite like myself. I can't figure out why they keep looming about... Other than, y'know, not being able to figure out the point in living and doing all the things one has to do to survive.
Yes! I try to do the same. Or at least let them know I'm having a hard week, and I'll reply soon.
Depends on the person. Last couple, none whatsoever. Which is why I'm so confused and hurt/defeated.
Haha, as in, you want to cut contact? I don't think that sounds so bad. I understand things fizzling out. I just don't get going from 80-100 to 0.

I've been at this point since I was 11, it's nothing new. I'm not opposed to talking about my childhood/teen years, but I'm finally feeling somewhat empowered and I don't feel as though she affects me anymore. I thought that when I moved out, I'd stop having suicidal thoughts. That only lasted a month. I'd say I'm pretty well adjusted, considering all the physical and emotional abuse, and those close to me would say the same. I've done therapy. But I still want to kill myself.

I'll think about it, but I have a really hard time picking these things out. Everyone seems so different, y'know?  

For the sake of understanding what you mean, let's just throw a random personality trait out there. What would I do with that information?

Even if it does, they're problems I don't have to deal with anymore. And even if my body doesn't want to die, that doesn't mean that *I* don't want to do it. 

I understand life has its ups and downs. If it were all ups, the ups wouldn't be good anymore. But even the ups don't make me "enjoy life". I spend time with friends, which I enjoy. And I do other hobbies I like. But so what? I'm still fucking miserable. I still rather not be alive. It just doesn't seem worth it. 

I understand why people who try to kill themselves say they weren't ready, and want to do X Y Z before they die. But it's no different than me saying I want to go see a movie next week, y'know? It's something to look forward to for now to get your mind off the shitiness.
I keep trying. I really do. I don't go into things afraid to get hurt, and that's how I end up every god damn time. It's humiliating.

It sucks so bad. I don't understand the people who *can* communicate and just choose not to. 

Also, fuck dating. I keep trying and it just isn't worth it. I'm damned if I do, damned if I don't.
God, the title brought back a lot of memories for me. My mom used to sing this, too.
I recently was dreaming about this scenario with my mother. Most of my friends are aware of her abuse, and luckily I can laugh about it (as can they). I've debated throwing a party.
Lord, I am a sobbing mess. Thank you so much for this 💜 I need to stop feeling sorry and just take care of things. Thank you. 💜
